nuggets.text: The Golden Hurricane beat Oklahoma State in back-to-back seasons for the first time since 1951 and 1952.
The Golden Hurricane forced four turnovers and stopped Oklahoma State four times on fourth down in the opener.
TV's Dr. Phil McGraw played middle linebacker for the Golden Hurricane on a football scholarship in 1968.
The Golden Hurricane name came from a team vote to replace Golden Tornadoes, a nickname Georgia Tech already had.
Golden Hurricane coach Tre Lamb is the nephew of longtime coach Bobby Lamb and cousin of Appalachian State's Taylor Lamb.
Tre Lamb quarterbacked Tennessee Tech to its first Ohio Valley Conference title in 36 years in 2011.
Golden Hurricane great Steve Largent later served in the U.S. House and ran for governor of Oklahoma.
The Golden Hurricane christened Skelly Field in 1930 by beating Arkansas 26-6.
The Golden Hurricane's opening win was their first home victory over Oklahoma State since 1998.
The Golden Hurricane have played Sam Houston only once before, a Tulsa win in 2009.
